not_measured.edit_recompute: CX-04 (totals recomputed after an edit) needs an edit; tests/v05-structure holds it on engine/edit.mjs
not_measured.release_line_printed: R4-SCP-01 / R4-SCP-02 (the release line on every view, EN and ES) is a property of the rendered text; tests/v05-words holds it on engine/render.mjs - the scorer checks the stamp (liability_gate)
not_measured.profile_confidence: R4-SCP-03 is model data (model/profiles.json), not a plan field
not_measured.default_order_violations: observed default orders are selection preferences; not re-implemented
not_measured.plane_mix_error: contra / ipsi and plane shares are not in the plan JSON

group_count_exempt_formats.source: scorer (a timed circuit's stations are the format's own count)

value.status: approved (R4-SES-04): the person picks what to keep or take away; the plan only names the easiest

set_bounds_skip_formats.source: scorer (rounds x stations are the circuit format's own dose)

value.close_status: PROPOSED (V4, G-52): an optional-day Focus slot closes when the group's exercises at their fewest sets already hold more than its planned final sets; the main days' template lifts never close

value.status: approved: the final target is reached, faster steps allowed (CX-01); reached in the last week, one week early at most (R4-PRG-01); a note when a week adds more than about 15 % (R4-PRG-02); the same sets may hold while reps or load progress (CX-02 / CX-03). PROPOSED detail: a single whole set is never noted (note_min_whole_sets 2) - it is the smallest step a group can take

order_reading.source: T0-SES-05 / -06 (one position per pattern); "every" = the plain-text reading

bilateral_first_regions.source: BRAIN 6 order table ("bilateral before unilateral (same region)", OBSERVED on lower-body lifts); add "upper" to check the presses and pulls too

value.eligible: last small-muscle (side / rear delts, biceps, triceps, calves) or machine isolation exercise of the day
value.status: COACH-R3 R3-VOL-04 (last week); one per day PROPOSED

value.after_pair_status: PROPOSED (F3, E-118): each item's own class rest; the pair rests the longest

heavy_compound.status: PROPOSED (fix round 2 / F3): the time model still counts these sets at the hypertrophy rest (about 1 min a set short) - open for the time model

value.status: PROPOSED (v1.2 review; B2: capacity scaling, climb, test-week hold, both legs counted)
value.r2_status: PROPOSED (fix round 2 / F2, E-160): families, the 85 % line

athletic_attainment_min.source: scorer (planned dose under 0.9 x the scaled target)

athletic_test_replaced_counts.source: R2-PER-07 (a timed test takes the place of the station of its quality)

value.credits_status: PROPOSED (F1, E-89): joint care credits no muscle (was by_catalog)
value.r2_status: PROPOSED (fix round 2 / F2, E-175): 2 sets, inside the rests
value.v2_status: V2 (R4-LIB-01): a joint-care station is placed only when its code has a live exercise; a code whose exercises are all optional add-ons (Achilles / calf, balance) is offered as an add-on instead

value.sport_share_note: 'sport' = SportDef.share (from 04 v1.1 profiles[].bilateral_unilateral; block_start -> block_end over the exercise blocks; PRE / IN from pre_season / in_season)

value.status: area map, factor 0.6, freeze handling PROPOSED

pain_area_region.source: scorer (INFERRED): the body region an area's avoid tags apply to - a fixed grip matters to a sore shoulder on a press or a pull, not on a calf raise; worse_with tags apply everywhere

two_line_groups.source: scorer: one ceiling per FOCUS group (hips = glutes + hamstrings)

myo_not_in_superset.source: scorer: false = VOL-15 literal (the MYO set is on the day's last eligible exercise); true = engine E-158 (an exercise inside a superset is not eligible)

ab_compound_slots.source: COACH-R4 R4-SES-05 (slots 1-4 of Day A / Day B)

ab_small_slots.source: COACH-R4 R4-SES-05 (slots 5-6 of Day A / Day B, gym skeletons)

skeleton_day_of.source: engine/DECISIONS G-04 (skeleton ids of the templates)

skeleton_patterns.source: COACH-R4 R4-SES-05 (A = pull + knee dominant, B = push + hip dominant; push / pull / legs as in his sheets)

pattern_of_bucket.source: scorer: the movement pattern a template slot names

lift_blocks.source: scorer: the blocks that hold the template's lifts

value.status: approved rule (R4-SES-05: his template names each slot's laterality; OBSERVED BYOP categories); INFERRED: the athletic days keep the dial (UNI-02 / UNI-03 "field athletes ... more like 80 % or 90 % unilateral work") - open question for the coach; the penalty weight is PROPOSED

athletic_end_test_week_dose_ok.source: engine E-165 / E-172 (R2-PER-07): on the tested days of a block's end-test week the athletic and Olympic work runs the baseline week's dose, so the fall from the week before is the rule, not a drop; false = count it

absent_ok_whys.source: scorer: the reasons a day states for a station it leaves out (R4-SES-04 "said")

value.not_shown_note: neck work stays proposed until the coach decides (R4-LIB-01): never a pick, a swap or an offered add-on

primary_exceptions.status: approved (R4-LIB-01): wall balls and sled pushes may be primary in the HYROX program
PROPOSED reading of "maybe in the CrossFit program" (R4-LIB-01): on for the class WOD; set enabled false to keep them out

offer.status: PROPOSED (V2, G-28): which add-ons a plan lists and how many; the person adds any library exercise with an edit

value.status: approved (R4-LIB-01): the 31 proposed exercises are optional - "they can be chosen and added, but not primary ones that the program is going to throw at you as part of the template"

approved (R4-LIB-03): bodybuilders and the general population bias incline pressing over overhead pressing in the vertical / mid-range push slot; overhead stays available. PROPOSED: the weight; the non-competitive "stay athletic" adult counts as general population

incline_majority.source: COACH-R4 R4-LIB-03 ("bias incline pressing"), read as at least half of the slot's picks in a training block
